channelMetadataRenderer.title: Dr M Medical Courses
channelMetadataRenderer.description:
My goal is to make medicine easier to learn, and I take a long time to figure out an easier way to teach each topic I make videos about, that is why my classes take long times to be made and published...

All my classes are in playlists that you can find in the Playlist section of my channel... 

Hello, My name is Mustafa Salahalden and I'm a Medical Doctor, PGY4, Pathology resident
I make free online videos and classes that help you learn medicine 
If you're a physician, nurse, paramedic or anyone who is interested in learning medicine then this channel is for you...

Disclaimer: Please be aware that this YouTube channel is not meant to offer diagnoses, treatments, or medical guidance. The content featured on this channel is solely intended for informational purposes. It is strongly advised to seek advice from a qualified physician or healthcare expert regarding any medical or health-related concerns or treatment choices.
